_doc: The user-confirmed RINEX 2 <-> 3 code policies (docs/DECISIONS.md 'Policy defaults the user should confirm', confirmed 2026-11-01, answer 7), written here by hand from that text and PLAN section 3.5, NOT from rinexconv/codemap.py, for tests/independent (headers._v2v3_attributes, compare.compare_obs). v2_to_v3: the default attribute of each RINEX 2 code (assumption source 'table'). DECISIONS gives the C/P/L codes per system, 'Galileo band n -> nX' and 'SBAS C1 -> C1C, band 5 -> 5X'; the D and S codes of a band, GPS L5 and SBAS L1 are INFERRED to take the attribute of the band's phase (or code) as listed, the same rule DECISIONS states for the L2C receiver ('GPS L2/D2/S2 become 2X'). Systems RINEX 2 does not define (J, C, I) have no confirmed default here: only the signal class is checked for them. l2_follows_code: 'When a v2 file has C2 but no P2 (an L2C receiver), GPS L2/D2/S2 become 2X and GLONASS 2C' (source 'receiver-rule:L2-follows-code'). collapse_priority: the RINEX 3 -> 2 attribute order per system and band, best first: 'GPS band 1 C>W>P>Y..., band 2 W>P>Y>D...>C>L>S>X; GLONASS band 1 C>P, band 2 P>C; Galileo C>X>B>A>Z (pilot first), bands 5/7/8 Q>X>I'. A '|' marks a gap the text leaves open ('...'): every attribute before it beats every one after it; attributes not listed are not compared. Galileo 'C>X>B>A>Z' is applied to bands 1 and 6, the bands with A/B/C/X/Z attributes (rinex305.txt Table 5).
